verdict.rationale: OpenTofu is an open-source CLI that users install and run on their own machines. Its docs cover many installation methods (Homebrew, standalone binaries for Linux/macOS/Windows/FreeBSD, an official OCI container image), and the manifesto states it is truly open source under the Linux Foundation, so the core product is entirely self-run. Missing for 10: the specific license is not named in the evidence, there is no explicit self-hosting guide for the remote state backend or collaboration infrastructure, and there is little independent hands-on corroboration beyond community migration reports.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: You can install OpenTofu via a wide range of methods.
Use official OCI container image available on GitHub Container Registry.
Use OpenTofu without installation on Linux, MacOS, Windows or FreeBSD.
Now that we are part of the Linux Foundation, we can guarantee that OpenTofu will remain: Truly open source
